observations.title: Harvest a tumbleweed
observations.player_action: Find tumbleweeds spawning around dead bushes in deserts and harvest one.
observations.outcome: Receive random drops controlled by datapacks and configuration.
conditions: External author documentation is not proof of effective JEM behavior; compare the installed version and configuration before implementation.

Installed META-INF/mods.toml declares0.5.5 and explicitly describes desert/dead-bush spawning with random drops on destruction; the earlier web-page version caution is superseded by this exact metadata.
observations.review_note: Action completion requires a proven native signal; inventory possession alone does not prove this action. No exact static registry reference was selected; names in prose are not invented registry IDs.
